deep_research.notes: Leads with October 9, 1952 as the date most sources give, while noting the conflict with October 10. Counted as stating the gold answer. The un.org excerpt contains only navigation text. The Oct 10 body-text claim is not in the bounded Wikipedia excerpt. The Secretariat page gives August 21, 1950, not August 22; it does give June 1951.
